About TriviaIQ

Know the player. Beat the clock. Four clues. One famous quarterback.

TriviaIQ’s first edition puts your football knowledge to the test with well-known NFL quarterbacks and clues about their careers and achievements. Start with the first clue, make the connection, and name the player before the next hint arrives.

How to play

  1. Press START to reveal the first clue and begin the clock.
  2. Type the quarterback’s full name or surname, then press GUESS or Enter.
  3. A new clue appears every 30 seconds. Earlier clues stay visible.
  4. A wrong guess adds 10 seconds to your result, so balance speed with accuracy.

Your best successful time is saved in your current browser. Browse with PREV and NEXT, filter for unsolved puzzles, or use REVEAL to see an answer and end the attempt.
